title: Minimum brightness for OLED displays in HDR is entirely black vs dimmed in SDR

judgment.rationale: The report documents a high-impact black-screen result on an Alienware AW3423DW with HDR enabled and Power Display set to zero. A comment proposes extra-dim below the normal minimum, a separate request; first confirm the display-specific failure and a safe recovery path on current release.
evidence: Report identifies HDR OLED AW3423DW over DisplayPort, Windows 11 25H2, and RTX 4090.
Repro sets Power Display brightness to zero and says the panel becomes entirely black.
A commenter asks for extra-dim, which differs from the reporter’s requested SDR floor.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for a safe current reproduction and monitor firmware; separate the black-screen defect from extra-dim.

fix_assessment.rationale: The result may depend on monitor firmware and HDR/DDC behavior; do not propose a cross-device brightness clamp without a current reproduction and recovery details.

issue_context.summary: Power Display brightness zero reportedly makes an HDR OLED unusably black.
known_information: Reporter supplies monitor, GPU, OS build, connection, and repro.
Only comment proposes a separate extra-dim capability.
No current-release validation or monitor firmware is present.
inferences: Black output may be specific to the monitor’s HDR brightness mapping; behavior on other displays is unknown.
Desired SDR floor and extra-dim are distinct requirements.
issue_context.analysis: Validate current behavior and recovery without leaving the display unusable; do not conflate bug and feature request.
initial_investigation: Read report and comment; no linked fix or maintainer response.
Reviewed pinned Power Display IPC set executor; it delegates per-setting validation and hardware writes but does not establish HDR-specific output mapping for this monitor.

information_gaps.information: Whether setting brightness to zero still blacks out the named OLED in HDR on current release, plus monitor firmware version and whether hardware controls can restore the image.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is specific to an Alienware OLED, HDR, and a zero setting; the follow-up asks for extra-dim behavior, which is not the same as preserving an SDR floor. Current monitor-specific behavior must be distinguished from the separate feature request.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current release reproduce only if the monitor’s hardware controls can restore the picture. Record firmware and whether changing hardware brightness restores the image; do not leave the display unusable.

comment.body: Thanks for documenting the exact OLED and HDR setup. Could you confirm whether the black-screen result still occurs on the current release and share the monitor firmware version? Please only repeat the zero-brightness step if the monitor’s own controls can restore the picture. The extra-dim suggestion in the comments is a separate feature request from preserving a usable SDR-level minimum.
